estimand: Descriptive event counts and within-source time intervals; no dose alignment or cross-device clock reconstruction
interval_policy: Differences between successive observed entries, with original CSV row numbers retained; missing fields stay missing; no reconstructed timestamps
digital_policy: All exact native transitions retained; rise/fall by sign; pulse is a rise followed immediately by a fall returning to its initial level; polarity and clinical meaning unassigned
protocol_policy: Parse HH:MM:SS start labels into seconds; retain task/rest values in native units without claiming verified signal synchronization
